card.name: Joshua and Yehoshua name spellings
card.fires_on: The name Joshua or its pieces, such as the ending 'ua' in Yehoshua, 'Josh', and 'Jos' at the start of Jossey-Bass or Joslin. It appears mostly in biblical or Jewish-history text.

modes.label: Yehoshua ending
modes.description: The final 'ua' of the Hebrew name Yehoshua, for the biblical leader or a writer.
modes.example: The condition of the city during the days of Yehosh<<ua>>.

modes.label: Joshua as a person
modes.description: The name Joshua after a title or 'and also'.
modes.example: FDA Deputy Commissioner<< Joshua>> Sharfstein took the bold, unprecedented

modes.label: Jos- name starts
modes.description: The start of names like Josh, Jossey-Bass or Joslin.
modes.example: According to experts at the<< Jos>>lin Diabetes Center

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are mostly unrelated word pieces and the promoted ones are unrelated too, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the name Joshua (or Yehoshua) and the start of similar names like Josh or Joslin.
